{{Quote|If you get to the lower levels find a slave named Akkus. He's been bragging that he knows how to get access to the security areas. Tell him I sent you and find out if he's telling the truth.|[[Noro Bok]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:IE" />}}
'''Akkus Meik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Meik was captured by the [[Corellian slavers]] and [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] in the [[Corellian Slaver Bunker]] near [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]].<ref name="SWG:IE" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a spacer infiltrated the bunker to find evidence of the slaver operations for the [[Corellian Security Force]]. Akkus Meik agreed to help the spacer to access to the detention areas of the bunker. Thanks to Meik's assistance, the spacer was able to explore all the areas of the bunker and eventually broadcasted the slavers' records on the CorSec emergency request channels.<ref name="SWG:IE" /> Dozens of CorSec agents quickly moved to the slaver bunker and freed all the slaves.<ref name="SWG:HbtKS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Head back to Kyran Silene|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommoner.png|250px|thumb|Every possible depictions of Akkus Meik]]
Akkus Meik was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:IE" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Akkus Meik was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>

Because Akkus Meik spawned under the generic "commoner" template, his appearance was randomly generated among 120 possible appearances. This included [[Human/Legends|Humans]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]], [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]], [[Bith/Legends|Bith]], [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]], and [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]] of either [[Gender/Legends|gender]], and male [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronians]], [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]], [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]], and [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]]. However the quest dialogues identified him as a male.<ref name="SWG:IE" />
